query:
SELECT
                    jl.id,
                    jl.job_id,
                    jl.run_number,
                    jl.attempt,
                    jl.level,
                    jl.occurred_at
                 FROM job_logs jl
                 JOIN job_queue jq ON jq.id = jl.job_id
                 WHERE jl.job_id = $1
                   AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR jq.organization_id = $2)
                   AND ($3::bigint IS NULL OR jl.id < $3)
                 ORDER BY jl.id DESC
                 LIMIT $4
